elsewhere.note: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up Yahweh’s inheritance?”
Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
